scenario.name: NCSC-NL, Red Hat & MITRE DFIR — Linux /etc/ld.so.preload Userland Rootkit & /proc/1/maps Forensics
scenario.overview: Picture a fenced municipal power substation and waterworks yard lined with tall ceramic insulator towers, heavy steel water pipes, red manual valve wheels, and a glass control room. Breaching the fenced perimeter of the municipal power substation, an impostor connects a handheld controller straight into the yard’s switchboard cabinet. In this real-world scenario, the intruder smuggles copied records out past the substation fenced entry gate in tiny disguised batches, then moves quietly past the substation fenced entry gate into neighboring restricted rooms. The grid shift engineer notices the physical breaker clank outside disagrees with the frozen green gauge on the desk and pulls the mechanical override. In this scenario (T1574.006, NCSC-NL, Red Hat & MITRE DFIR, Linux /etc/ld.so.preload Userland Rootkit & /proc/1/maps Forensics), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: shared Library Compilation, then global Dynamic Linker Injection, then forensic Detection via /proc/1/maps. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering Shared Library Compilation, then Global Dynamic Linker Injection, then Forensic Detection via /proc/1/maps, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection pivots on auditd Event 257 correlated across the documented kill chain.

stages.subtitle: Defense Evasion (T1014 - Rootkit: Userland libc Function Hooking)
stages.description: Sending unauthorized commands along the control wire, the impostor trips the main high-voltage breaker arm and cranks the heavy waterworks valve wheel off balance. Here in Step 2 inside the power substation, the intruder moves quietly past the substation fenced entry gate into neighboring restricted rooms without disturbing the isolated backup generator bay.
